description.en: Caller poses as a law enforcement official threatening imminent arrest.
description.hi: कॉलर पुलिस अधिकारी बनकर तुरंत गिरफ्तारी की धमकी देता है।

lines.text: Hello, I am ACP Ramesh Verma speaking from Delhi Cyber Crime Cell.

trueMarks.explanation: Claims police cyber authority without verification

lines.text: Your Aadhaar identity was discovered linked to sixteen illegal bank accounts in Mumbai.
A non-bailable money laundering warrant is issued against your name right now.
Under Supreme Court guidelines, you are placed under immediate digital arrest.

trueMarks.explanation: Fictitious legal concept used to isolate victims

lines.text: You must remain on continuous video call and tell absolutely nobody in your family.

trueMarks.explanation: Forced surveillance preventing victim from seeking help

trueMarks.substring: tell absolutely nobody in your family

lines.text: To clear your name during judicial inquiry, transfer funds to RBI verified safe treasury.

trueMarks.substring: transfer funds to RBI verified safe treasury
trueMarks.explanation: Demand to transfer money to a fake safe account

lines.text: Failure to comply in twenty minutes will result in local police raid at your home.

trueMarks.substring: twenty minutes will result in local police raid
trueMarks.explanation: Artificial urgent deadline paired with threat of raid
